message.content:
**Northbank Community Garden: North Gate Closure on Saturday 18 April**

The north gate will be closed this Saturday, 18 April, from 9 am to 2 pm. A water pipe beneath the gate path has been leaking for several weeks, and the repair needs the whole stretch of path dug up. Please don't try to squeeze past the work area. The ground will be open and uneven.

Use the east entrance during the closure. It is the gate beside the compost bins, and it will stay unlocked for the full five hours. The route to the main beds is slightly longer from that side, so allow a few extra minutes if you are coming to water.

**Seed swap moved to Sunday**

Because of the repair, the seed swap will not take place on Saturday. It is now on Sunday 19 April at 11 am. The north gate will be open again by then, and the tables will be set up in the usual spot near the shed.

**Volunteers needed**

We could use extra hands on Saturday to clear the soon-to-be-disturbed edges of the path and move pots out of the way. Please bring your own gloves. Tools are supplied.

Mina, one of our residents, is coordinating volunteers. Tell her you are coming, or find her at the east entrance on Saturday morning.

Thank you for your patience while the pipe is fixed.
